change_log.notes: بازطراحی پوسته کنترل‌پنل: فارسی/RTL، تم روشن+تاریک، IA runtime-backed و Embedded Chat.
Session/logout/key hashing و اصلاحات تراکم UI؛ کلیدهای API فقط hash.
مدیریت Provider، ذخیره تنظیمات و بهبود چیدمان و کنترل‌ها.
بازطراحی فرایندمحور Runtime/Profile/Provider، ثبت Mission/Playbook به‌عنوان مرجع حاکمیتی و آغاز قرارداد نسخه‌دار Provider Profile/Account Instance.
موتور کاوشگر فرایندمحور با Behavior Lab، AI-assisted discovery مبتنی بر مجوز، Routing policy نسخه‌دار و Work Register ضدفراموشی.
بازطراحی رابطه‌محور Control Plane: Browser Runtime grouping، Provider provisioning مرحله‌ای، حذف ورودی خام CDP/Profile و ثبت غیرفعال تا Certification.
Mission-driven Control Plane audit: human-understandable entity relationships, readiness/certification gating, actual service topology and structured Evidence separation.
Embedded Chat canonical uploads, provider-side Stop/cancellation, User-View discovery states و media qualification عملیاتی.
Release closure candidate: outbound traffic observability, honest token telemetry, DeepSeek readiness revalidation, synchronized release metadata.
RC2 supersedes RC1 after documentation encoding defect was detected during GitHub verification; no production cutover occurred.
RC3 adds explicit production deployment-profile isolation for port 5000 and Windows service configuration.
E2 operational release after controlled production cutover, verified rollback/restore, production restart recovery, and bounded provider smoke. E3 reliability is not claimed.
Final E2 operational release after RC4 exact preflight, controlled cutover, rollback/restore and production restart recovery. E3 reliability not claimed.
Post-2.1.0 full-panel audit remediation: fail-closed service controls, runtime-gated account readiness, explicit model loading state, and raw YAML accessibility labels.
Full-panel audit pass 2: complete Models capability matrix across registered providers and contain Overview charts/status labels at responsive widths.
Full-product audit pass 3: encoding-safe provider routing labels and independent Session/Readiness evidence timestamps on Account cards.
Encoding-safe correction of all Persian labels introduced by the full-product audit; preserves pass-3 Session/Readiness evidence separation.
Synchronize provider-certification test contract with the valid Production W2 replacement while preserving E3_IN_PROGRESS until W3.
Full-product audit safety: bind all service-manager status/start/stop actions to the active HWG_CONFIG_PATH deployment profile to prevent Dev/Production target confusion.
Full-product audit P0: bind Control Plane service actions to the active HWG_CONFIG_PATH deployment profile; prevents Dev/Production service target confusion.
Full-product audit safety: enforce Current READY evidence in backend before any disabled-to-enabled Provider transition; prevents API bypass of the UI readiness gate.
Provider lifecycle audit: enforce current READY evidence in backend before enabling any previously-disabled provider; UI and API now share the same fail-closed activation contract.
Config governance audit: validate candidate structure, security/runtime invariants, deployment port identity, and Provider readiness transitions before any config write or restart.
Config audit: fail-closed loading/write controls and backend bounds aligned with the UI contract.
Desktop Runtime Agent resilience: allow operation on battery, do not stop when switching to battery, and start when available while preserving restart-on-failure.
Conversation lifecycle audit: /v1/chat/conversation now creates and reuses the MCP session represented by the Sessions workspace.
Embedded Chat fail-closed readiness gate: initial/loading selectors and Send stay disabled, and sendMessage revalidates current READY evidence to prevent Enter/direct-call bypass.
Chat lifecycle audit: make embedded Chat initialization idempotent so repeated workspace navigation cannot duplicate event handlers or send actions.

Destructive/governance action hardening: backend confirmation gates for Provider deletion, API-key create/delete, Auth state changes, and Discovery review decisions; UI sends explicit confirmation evidence.
Desktop Runtime Agent watchdog continuously recovers dead enabled CDP runtimes and exposes watchdog health/recovery counters.
Desktop Runtime Agent scheduled task now launches a persistent supervisor wrapper that restarts the Python agent child after unexpected exit; browser watchdog remains active inside the agent.

Connection Profile domain/UX baseline: mission-driven primary navigation, Provider-centric multi-account profiles, editable suggested profile naming, and preservation of integrated Explorer Live View.
DeepSeek login-page classifier recognizes visible credential surfaces in dedicated Connection Profile runtimes; preserves visual-first login gating.
Fail closed on guest-capable web-chat composers: composer visibility alone is not authenticated evidence for dedicated Connection Profiles.
Account lifecycle maps fail-closed guest candidates requiring login to LOGIN_REQUIRED while raw discovery remains UNKNOWN.

Connection Profile workflow: dedicated Account runtimes become first-class Explorer targets; exact-scope certification is visible; create profile starts isolated runtime and opens login; existing profiles can continue into Explorer with scoped Live View.

Existing default Connection Profiles resolve their owning shared Provider runtime in Explorer and use human-readable Provider / حساب اصلی labels; dedicated accounts retain exact-account runtime routing.

Primary Provider workspace replaces raw Runtime/CDP with a human connection-environment label and collapsed technical details; secondary-account Provider-level readiness is fail-closed to prevent probing the wrong account.
New Web Chat start and existing Provider Wizard qualification/resume are unified under the Exploration & Preparation workspace; the large live Wizard status panel is removed from Providers.
Exploration and Preparation workspace now prioritizes existing Qualification resume, collapses technical Discovery process details, and visually separates advanced Discovery runs.
Structured tool-bearing OpenAI-compatible requests bypass implicit human-chat CAG filtering; explicit boundary flags still remain authoritative.
DeepSeek/Kilo continuation now repairs the observed DOM-deescaped PowerShell command envelope with embedded quotes and Windows path separators before strict JSON parsing.
Tool protocol now requires one fenced JSON block and one combined tool_calls array so Web Chat Markdown rendering preserves underscores, backslashes, quotes, and code payloads.
Bounded parser repair accepts malformed Web-chat shell command JSON where quoted shell arguments are separated by commas, while retaining normal JSON-key termination and fail-closed parsing.
Bounded terminal-delimiter recovery now accepts structurally complete Web-chat tool envelopes missing only final array/object closers; unterminated strings and mismatched structures remain rejected.
Web-chat agent protocol now limits each turn to one tool call and requires explicit JSON escaping for code/file strings; bounded parser recovery remains fail-closed.
Tool-protocol regression contract synchronized with the new one-call-per-turn reliability rule.
Path-like tool arguments now restore Windows separators that JSON decoded into forbidden ASCII control characters such as tab from \t.
Serialized assistant tool-call history is now fenced as JSON so Web Chat continuation preserves underscores, backslashes and quoted source content across tool turns.
Bounded structural recovery now inserts only an unambiguous missing object/array closer before an observed enclosing closer; unmatched extra closers remain rejected.

Tool parser now recognizes only known fenced-code renderer chrome labels (json/Copy/Download) before a tool envelope and removes those labels from normalized assistant content; arbitrary prose prefixes remain rejected.
Negative renderer-chrome regression now targets prose-prefixed malformed JSON requiring repair; existing valid prose-plus-tool parsing behavior remains unchanged.

Real VS Code/Kilo mission test completed through HWG/DeepSeek: project generation, 64 unittest PASS, real CLI add/list/done/search smoke PASS, with bounded tool-protocol remediation; clean fresh-workspace rerun remains required.
Discovery architecture contract test synchronized to Work Register 1.63.0 after registering the Kilo/VS Code primary mission acceptance item.
Final mission-E2 source hygiene: normalized tool_protocol EOF after Unicode literal restoration; no semantic protocol change.
CAG removed from HWG runtime/domain contracts. Callers own external CAG workflows; HWG retains only generic none/policy/approval authorization.
